test.create_query: CREATE TABLE lc_filter_short_circuit ( id UInt64, s LowCardinality(String), pad String ) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY id
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO lc_filter_short_circuit SELECT number, if(number % 2 = 0, 'a', 'b'), leftPad(toString(sipHash64(number)), 64, '0') FROM numbers(10000000)
test.query: SELECT sum(length(pad)) FROM lc_filter_short_circuit WHERE s IN ('z') SETTINGS optimize_move_to_prewhere = 0, use_query_condition_cache = 0
SELECT sum(length(pad)) FROM lc_filter_short_circuit PREWHERE s IN ('z') SETTINGS use_query_condition_cache = 0
